import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 1000009;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long modExp(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur_base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * cur_base) % mod;
            }
            cur_base = (cur_base * cur_base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int[] visited = new int[N];
        long answer = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                answer = (answer * p) % MOD;
            }
            System.out.println(answer);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
            if (visited[i] != 0) continue;
            int j = i, d = 0;
            do {
                visited[j] = ++d;
                j = (int)((long)j * k % p);
            } while (visited[j] == 0);
            if (modExp(k, d, p) == 1) {
                answer = (answer * p) % MOD;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
